body:
Sky Detectives: 1. The sky: the sun, the clouds, and the trees. 2. Rain. 3. The leaves are moving. 4. Drawing shows a sky with white, puffy clouds.
My Weather Picture: answers depend on the day. The drawing and the told sentence match the real weather (for example, "Today it is cloudy. I see gray clouds in the sky.").
Our Weather Week: 1. 3 sunny days. 2. 1 rainy day. 3. Sunny. 4. Drawing shows rain (rain drops or rain clouds).
Weather Words Check: 1. Rainy (or rain). 2. Sunny. 3. Windy. 4. 4 clouds. 5. Drawing and word match today's weather.
Scoring tip: a student who points to the right weather card but cannot yet say the word is Getting there on "I can say weather words". Score the drawing on what it shows about the weather, not on how neat it is.
title: Answer key: Look Up! What Is the Weather?
